t: Guide To Setting up a Node.js Monorepo With Lerna
s: September 8, 2023 - Lerna is a tool designed for managing repositories that contain multiple npm packages. It simplifies handling dependencies, releases, and publishing packages within multi-package repositories housed in a single git repository. Lerna is specifically useful for monorepo, as it enables efficient code sharing and collaboration among developers working on different npm packages within the same repository.
